node.title: Re^4: Doing every X seconds
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I cannot find a single correct statement in your post, even after careful testing of each point you make ... For example, if ($child) will likely be undef, so what?

At a minimum, the statement "upon failure to fork you'll get undef" is certainly correct, and [doc://fork] certainly can fail. In your updated code you're still not checking for the definedness of $child. See also the various [doc://fork] examples in [doc://perlfork] and [doc://perlipc].
